problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate computing workloads across three server clusters to three data centers, aiming to minimize the total processing latency.

The available processing capacity at each server cluster (set X) is as follows:
*Cluster X1 has a capacity of 64 units.
*Cluster X2 has a capacity of 108 units.
*Cluster X3 has a capacity of 58 units.

The required computational load that must be handled at each data center (set Y) is specified below:
*Data center Y1 requires 59 units.
*Data center Y2 requires 10 units.
*Data center Y3 requires 133 units.

The unit latency cost for processing a workload from each cluster at each data center is as follows:
| Source / Destination | Y1 | Y2 | Y3 |
|--|-|-|
| X1 | 19 | 11 | 7 |
| X2 | 16 | 13 | 15 |
| X3 | 5 | 9 | 5 |

Determine the optimal distribution of workloads to minimize the aggregate latency cost.
